instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Introduction and the four strategic principles

questions.question: What does web application security encompass?
questions.question_ar: شنو يشمل أمن تطبيقات الويب؟
options: Physical controls and datacentre access logging.
Strategies, tools and practices that protect web apps.
Firewalls, proxies and VPNs deployed at the edge.
Encryption keys and certificate lifecycle management.
options_ar: ضوابط فيزيائية وتسجيل دخول مركز البيانات.
استراتيجيات وأدوات وممارسات تحمي تطبيقات الويب.
جدارات وبروكسيات وشبكات خاصة عند الحافة.
مفاتيح التشفير وإدارة دورة حياة الشهادات.
options_en: Physical controls and datacentre access logging.
Strategies, tools and practices that protect web apps.
Firewalls, proxies and VPNs deployed at the edge.
Encryption keys and certificate lifecycle management.
questions.explanation: It is the subset of cybersecurity covering the strategies, tools and practices designed to protect web applications from malicious exploitation.
questions.explanation_ar: هو الجزء من الأمن السيبراني اللي يغطّي الاستراتيجيات والأدوات والممارسات المصمّمة لحماية تطبيقات الويب من الاستغلال الخبيث.

questions.question: Which consequences can a successful web application breach produce?
questions.question_ar: أي نتائج يقدر يخلّفها اختراق ناجح لتطبيق ويب؟
options: Slower compilation, larger binaries and longer tests.
Higher licensing costs and fewer cloud regions.
Shorter certificate lifetimes and more rotation.
Financial loss, reputational damage, penalties and disruption.
options_ar: ترجمة أبطأ وملفات تنفيذية أكبر واختبارات أطول.
كلف تراخيص أعلى ومناطق سحابية أقل.
خسائر مالية وضرر بالسمعة وعقوبات وتعطّل منهجي.
options_en: Slower compilation, larger binaries and longer tests.
Higher licensing costs and fewer cloud regions.
Shorter certificate lifetimes and more rotation.
Financial loss, reputational damage, penalties and disruption.
questions.explanation: Breaches can cause financial losses, reputational damage, regulatory penalties and systemic disruption.
questions.explanation_ar: الاختراقات تقدر تسبّب خسائر مالية وضرراً بالسمعة وعقوبات تنظيمية وتعطّلاً منهجياً.

questions.question: Beyond classic SQL injection and XSS, which threat classes does the chapter add?
questions.question_ar: ما عدا حقن SQL و XSS التقليديين، أي أصناف تهديد يضيفها الفصل؟
options: Bot campaigns, supply chain, API abuse and containers.
ARP poisoning, VLAN hopping and MAC flooding.
BGP hijacking, DNS poisoning and NTP abuse.
Disk wiping, log tampering and clock skew.
options_ar: حملات بوتات وسلسلة توريد وإساءة APIs وهجمات حاويات.
تسميم ARP وتجاوز VLAN وإغراق MAC.
اختطاف BGP وتسميم DNS وإساءة NTP.
مسح أقراص وتلاعب بالسجلات وانحراف ساعة.
options_en: Bot campaigns, supply chain, API abuse and containers.
ARP poisoning, VLAN hopping and MAC flooding.
BGP hijacking, DNS poisoning and NTP abuse.
Disk wiping, log tampering and clock skew.
questions.explanation: The landscape moved to bot-driven campaigns, supply chain compromises, API exploitation and attacks on containerised microservices.
questions.explanation_ar: المشهد انتقل لحملات مدفوعة بالبوتات، واختراقات سلسلة التوريد، واستغلال APIs، وهجمات على الخدمات المصغّرة داخل الحاويات.

questions.question: Toward which kind of paradigm has web application security shifted?
questions.question_ar: نحو أي نوع من النماذج تحوّل أمن تطبيقات الويب؟
options: Manual, periodic and audit-driven.
Passive, isolated and perimeter-only.
Proactive, adaptive and intelligence-driven.
Reactive, static and rule-bound.
options_en: Manual, periodic and audit-driven.
Passive, isolated and perimeter-only.
Proactive, adaptive and intelligence-driven.
Reactive, static and rule-bound.
questions.explanation: It moved from reacting to incidents toward anticipating them, using intelligence and automation rather than periodic manual review.
questions.explanation_ar: انتقل من ردّ الفعل على الحوادث إلى توقّعها، باستخدام الاستخبارات والأتمتة بدل المراجعة اليدوية الدورية.

questions.question: Which capabilities does that proactive paradigm integrate?
questions.question_ar: أي قدرات يدمجها ذلك النموذج الاستباقي؟
options: Backup rotation, tape archives and cold storage.
ML anomaly detection, automated patching and Zero Trust.
Manual code review, quarterly audits and ticketing.
Network segmentation, VPN concentrators and NAC.
options_ar: تدوير نسخ احتياطية وأرشيف شرائط وتخزين بارد.
كشف شذوذ بتعلّم الآلة وترقيع آلي ومبادئ Zero Trust.
مراجعة كود يدوية وتدقيق ربع سنوي وتذاكر.
تقسيم شبكي ومركّزات VPN و NAC.
options_en: Backup rotation, tape archives and cold storage.
ML anomaly detection, automated patching and Zero Trust.
Manual code review, quarterly audits and ticketing.
Network segmentation, VPN concentrators and NAC.
questions.explanation: Machine-learning anomaly detection, automated patching and Zero Trust principles are the three named ingredients.
questions.explanation_ar: كشف الشذوذ القائم على تعلّم الآلة، والترقيع الآلي، ومبادئ Zero Trust هي المكوّنات الثلاثة المذكورة.

questions.question: What distinguishes a strategic approach from a tactical response?
questions.question_ar: شنو يميّز المقاربة الاستراتيجية عن الاستجابة التكتيكية؟
options: Strategy fixes immediate flaws; tactics build long-term frameworks.
Strategy is cheaper; tactics are always more expensive.
Strategy is written down; tactics are only spoken.
Strategy builds long-term frameworks; tactics fix immediate flaws.
options_ar: الاستراتيجية تصلّح ثغرة فورية، والتكتيك يبني أطراً طويلة.
الاستراتيجية تبني أطراً طويلة الأمد، والتكتيك يصلّح ثغرة فورية.
options_en: Strategy fixes immediate flaws; tactics build long-term frameworks.
Strategy is cheaper; tactics are always more expensive.
Strategy is written down; tactics are only spoken.
Strategy builds long-term frameworks; tactics fix immediate flaws.
questions.explanation: Tactics address immediate vulnerabilities, while strategy anticipates evolving threats and aligns security with organisational objectives.
questions.explanation_ar: التكتيك يعالج الثغرات الفورية، أما الاستراتيجية فتتوقّع التهديدات المتطوّرة وتوائم الأمن مع أهداف المؤسسة.

questions.question: Why does the chapter call web applications part of a socio-technical system?
questions.question_ar: ليش الفصل يعدّ تطبيقات الويب جزءاً من نظام اجتماعي-تقني؟
options: Because they span infrastructure, people, governance and threats.
Because they are written by more than one programmer.
Because they run on more than one operating system.
Because they are regulated by more than one country.
options_ar: لأنها تشمل البنية التحتية والبشر والحوكمة والخصوم.
لأنها تعمل على أكثر من نظام تشغيل.
options_en: Because they span infrastructure, people, governance and threats.
Because they are written by more than one programmer.
Because they run on more than one operating system.
Because they are regulated by more than one country.
questions.explanation: The system includes infrastructure, human behaviour, governance and adversarial dynamics, so security cannot be reduced to code.
questions.explanation_ar: النظام يشمل البنية التحتية وسلوك الإنسان والحوكمة وديناميكيات الخصوم، فالأمن ما ينختزل بالكود.

questions.question: Which three attributes must a modern strategy have?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاث صفات لازم تكون بالاستراتيجية الحديثة؟
options: Manual, documented and quarterly.
Encrypted, signed and notarised.
Dynamic, multi-layered and adaptive.
Static, single-layered and predictable.
options_en: Manual, documented and quarterly.
Encrypted, signed and notarised.
Dynamic, multi-layered and adaptive.
Static, single-layered and predictable.
questions.explanation: It has to be dynamic, multi-layered and adaptive to keep pace with both technology and regulation.
questions.explanation_ar: لازم تكون ديناميكية ومتعددة الطبقات ومتكيّفة حتى تلحق التقنية والتنظيم معاً.

questions.question: Which two kinds of pressure must a modern strategy reflect?
questions.question_ar: أي نوعين من الضغط لازم تعكسهما الاستراتيجية الحديثة؟
options: Hardware refresh and datacentre leases.
Technological advances and regulatory pressure.
Vendor roadmaps and licensing renewals.
Staff turnover and training budgets.
options_en: Hardware refresh and datacentre leases.
Technological advances and regulatory pressure.
Vendor roadmaps and licensing renewals.
Staff turnover and training budgets.
questions.explanation: Cloud, APIs and AI on one side, and GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA on the other, both shape what a viable strategy looks like.
questions.explanation_ar: السحابة والـAPIs والذكاء الاصطناعي من جهة، و GDPR و CCPA و HIPAA من جهة ثانية، الاثنان يرسمان شكل الاستراتيجية القابلة للبقاء.

questions.question: What does Defense-in-Depth guarantee?
questions.question_ar: شنو يضمن الدفاع في العمق؟
options: That every vulnerability is found before deployment.
That attackers cannot reach the network at all.
That encryption is applied at every layer.
That no single vulnerability compromises the whole system.
options_ar: إن كل ثغرة تُكتشف قبل النشر.
إن المهاجمين ما يوصلون للشبكة أبداً.
إن ثغرة واحدة ما تقدر تخترق النظام كله.
options_en: That every vulnerability is found before deployment.
That attackers cannot reach the network at all.
That encryption is applied at every layer.
That no single vulnerability compromises the whole system.
questions.explanation: Multiple layers are deployed so that risk is mitigated even if one of them fails.
questions.explanation_ar: تُنشر طبقات متعددة بحيث يُخفَّف الخطر حتى لو فشلت إحداها.

questions.question: Which five layers does the chapter list for Defense-in-Depth?
questions.question_ar: أي خمس طبقات يذكرها الفصل للدفاع في العمق؟
options: Input validation, auth, monitoring, firewalls, encryption.
Routing, switching, NAT, DNS and DHCP services.
Backup, replication, archiving, imaging and recovery.
Coding, testing, staging, release and rollback gates.
options_ar: تحقّق المدخلات والمصادقة والمراقبة والجدارات والتشفير.
التوجيه والتبديل و NAT و DNS و DHCP.
النسخ الاحتياطي والتكرار والأرشفة والتصوير والتعافي.
options_en: Input validation, auth, monitoring, firewalls, encryption.
Routing, switching, NAT, DNS and DHCP services.
Backup, replication, archiving, imaging and recovery.
Coding, testing, staging, release and rollback gates.
questions.explanation: Input validation, authentication controls, intrusion monitoring, firewalls and encryption are the five named layers.
questions.explanation_ar: تحقّق المدخلات، وضوابط المصادقة، ومراقبة الاختراقات، والجدران النارية، والتشفير هي الطبقات الخمس المذكورة.

questions.question: How is the probability of system compromise modelled under layered defence?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُنمذَج احتمال اختراق النظام تحت الدفاع الطبقي؟
options: The product of each layer's effectiveness alone.
The average of the layers' effectiveness values.
The product of one minus each layer's effectiveness.
The sum of one minus each layer's effectiveness.
options_ar: حاصل ضرب فاعلية كل طبقة لوحدها.
حاصل ضرب واحد ناقص فاعلية كل طبقة.
مجموع واحد ناقص فاعلية كل طبقة.
options_en: The product of each layer's effectiveness alone.
The average of the layers' effectiveness values.
The product of one minus each layer's effectiveness.
The sum of one minus each layer's effectiveness.
questions.explanation: Compromise requires every independent layer to fail, so the failure probabilities multiply.
questions.explanation_ar: الاختراق يتطلّب فشل كل طبقة مستقلة، فاحتمالات الفشل تتضارب.

questions.question: Why does adding a layer reduce compromise probability exponentially?
questions.question_ar: ليش إضافة طبقة تقلّل احتمال الاختراق أُسّياً؟
options: Because effectiveness is measured on a log scale.
Because each factor is below one, so the product shrinks.
Because each layer adds a fixed amount of delay.
Because layers are removed as the system matures.
options_ar: لأن كل عامل أقل من واحد، فالحاصل يصغر.
لأن كل طبقة تضيف تأخيراً ثابتاً.
لأن الطبقات تُزال كل ما نضج النظام.
options_en: Because effectiveness is measured on a log scale.
Because each factor is below one, so the product shrinks.
Because each layer adds a fixed amount of delay.
Because layers are removed as the system matures.
questions.explanation: Three layers at 0.9 effectiveness each leave 0.001, so the benefit compounds rather than accumulating linearly.
questions.explanation_ar: ثلاث طبقات بفاعلية 0.9 لكل واحدة تترك 0.001، فالفائدة تتراكم مو تتجمع خطياً.

questions.question: What does Zero Trust reject?
questions.question_ar: شنو يرفض Zero Trust؟
options: Encryption of internal traffic.
Multi-factor authentication prompts.
Segmentation of internal subnets.
Implicit trust inside the network.
options_en: Encryption of internal traffic.
Multi-factor authentication prompts.
Segmentation of internal subnets.
Implicit trust inside the network.
questions.explanation: Every request, internal or external, is verified, so being inside the perimeter grants nothing by itself.
questions.explanation_ar: كل طلب، داخلي أو خارجي، يُتحقَّق منه، فوجودك داخل المحيط ما يعطيك شيئاً بحد ذاته.

questions.question: Which contextual attributes does Zero Trust verify against?
questions.question_ar: ضد أي سمات سياقية يتحقّق Zero Trust؟
options: Identity, device health, geolocation, behaviour.
Password length, expiry date and history.
Packet size, timing and direction.
Certificate issuer, serial and revocation.
options_ar: الهوية وصحة الجهاز والموقع الجغرافي والسلوك.
طول كلمة المرور وتاريخ انتهائها وسجلها.
options_en: Identity, device health, geolocation, behaviour.
Password length, expiry date and history.
Packet size, timing and direction.
Certificate issuer, serial and revocation.
questions.explanation: Identity, device health, geolocation and behavioural baselines are the four attributes the chapter names.
questions.explanation_ar: الهوية وصحة الجهاز والموقع الجغرافي والخطوط الأساسية للسلوك هي السمات الأربعة اللي يذكرها الفصل.

questions.question: What does Zero Trust specifically prevent in a web application?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمنعه Zero Trust تحديداً بتطبيق ويب؟
options: Denial of service against the web tier.
Supply chain compromise of a dependency.
Lateral movement after a credential is stolen.
Injection attacks against the login form.
options_ar: الحركة الجانبية بعد سرقة بيانات اعتماد.
options_en: Denial of service against the web tier.
Supply chain compromise of a dependency.
Lateral movement after a credential is stolen.
Injection attacks against the login form.
questions.explanation: Once a session is compromised, continuous verification stops the attacker from using it to reach other systems.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد اختراق جلسة، التحقّق المستمر يمنع المهاجم من استغلالها للوصول لأنظمة ثانية.

questions.question: What does security by design do differently from retrofitting?
questions.question_ar: شنو يسوي الأمن بالتصميم مختلفاً عن إضافة الدفاعات لاحقاً؟
options: It documents controls once the code is frozen.
It embeds security from the earliest development phases.
It adds a firewall after the first penetration test.
It hires a security team after the first breach.
options_ar: يدمج الأمن من أبكر مراحل التطوير.
يضيف جداراً نارياً بعد أول اختبار اختراق.
يوظّف فريق أمن بعد أول اختراق.
options_en: It documents controls once the code is frozen.
It embeds security from the earliest development phases.
It adds a firewall after the first penetration test.
It hires a security team after the first breach.
questions.explanation: Instead of adding defences later, secure coding, automated testing and vulnerability assessment enter the CI/CD pipeline.
questions.explanation_ar: بدل إضافة الدفاعات لاحقاً، تدخل البرمجة الآمنة والاختبار الآلي وتقييم الثغرات داخل خط CI/CD.

questions.question: What does security shifting left achieve?
questions.question_ar: شنو يحقّقه انزياح الأمن يساراً؟
options: Higher throughput of feature delivery.
Fewer environments to maintain overall.
Longer release cycles by design.
Lower cost and complexity of remediation.
options_en: Higher throughput of feature delivery.
Fewer environments to maintain overall.
Longer release cycles by design.
Lower cost and complexity of remediation.
questions.explanation: Finding a flaw in design or code costs far less than finding it in production, which is why the shift left matters economically.
questions.explanation_ar: إيجاد العيب بالتصميم أو الكود يكلّف أقل بكثير من إيجاده بالإنتاج، ولهذا الانزياح يساراً يهم اقتصادياً.

questions.question: Why is risk-based prioritization necessary?
questions.question_ar: ليش الترتيب القائم على المخاطر ضروري؟
options: Because security resources are finite.
Because all vulnerabilities are equally severe.
Because regulators require a fixed order.
Because scanners cannot rank findings.
options_ar: لأن الجهات التنظيمية تفرض ترتيباً ثابتاً.
لأن الفاحصات ما تعرف ترتّب النتائج.
options_en: Because security resources are finite.
Because all vulnerabilities are equally severe.
Because regulators require a fixed order.
Because scanners cannot rank findings.
questions.explanation: With finite budget and attention, the strategy has to rank by likelihood, severity and potential impact.
questions.explanation_ar: بميزانية وانتباه محدودين، لازم الاستراتيجية ترتّب حسب الاحتمالية والخطورة والأثر المحتمل.

questions.question: Which two frameworks underpin risk-based prioritization?
questions.question_ar: أي إطارين يقوم عليهما الترتيب القائم على المخاطر؟
options: ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
STRIDE and DREAD.
CVSS and FAIR.
OCTAVE and COBIT.
options_en: ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
STRIDE and DREAD.
CVSS and FAIR.
OCTAVE and COBIT.
questions.explanation: CVSS scores the technical severity of a vulnerability, while FAIR analyses information risk quantitatively and financially.
questions.explanation_ar: CVSS يعطي درجة تقنية لخطورة الثغرة، و FAIR يحلّل مخاطر المعلومات كمياً ومالياً.
